Which of my documents or permits expire in the next six months?

response.text:
Two items expire in the next six months:

- **Residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis)** — expires Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. Make sure your extension application is filed with the Ausländerbehörde [party:pty_7jmdemeegmw0] before this date; otherwise lawful residence status ends when it expires.
- **Passport** — expires Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse]. Renew it before then if you still need it for travel.

Both are listed as open to-dos in Ordnung — you can mark them done or add reminders to your calendar once handled.
